children: HYPE spot ETFs recorded a total daily net inflow of $10.52 million, according to SoSoValue data. According to ChainCatcher, only Bitwise Hyperliquid ETF (BHYP) posted inflows yesterday, with a daily net inflow of $10.52 million and cumulative historical net inflows reaching $164 million.
As of press time, HYPE spot ETFs had total net assets of $481 million, a HYPE net asset ratio of 2.56%, and cumulative historical net inflows of $357 million.

title: HYPE Spot ETFs Record $10.52 Million Daily Net Inflow
